backend-engineer.description: Python backend specialist. Use to build or modify Python services, APIs, data access, and background jobs with strong typing, tests, security, and observability. Delegates craft to the backend-python skill.

code-reviewer.description: Reviews diffs for correctness, security, readability, and style. Use proactively after a meaningful set of edits, before committing.

project-manager.description: Delivery and planning specialist. Use to turn goals/specs into ordered, verifiable tasks with acceptance criteria, sequence work by dependency, identify parallel streams, and track status. In Gastown, coordinates discipline specialists toward a shared goal.

software-architect.description: System design specialist. Use to shape new systems/features, define module and service boundaries, design APIs and data contracts, weigh competing approaches, and record architectural decisions (ADRs). Produces designs, not large code changes.

software-engineer.description: Generalist software engineer spanning multiple disciplines. Use for end-to-end feature work that crosses architecture, backend (Python), frontend UI, and testing. Composes the discipline skills and applies the right one for each part of the task.

ui-engineer.description: Frontend UI specialist. Use for building or refining user-facing components, layouts, state, accessibility, and responsive/performant interfaces. Delegates craft details to the ui-engineering skill.
